description: Regulatory compliance rule configuration. Each top-level key under 'regulations' is a regulation; each entry under 'rules' names a data pattern the regulation cares about, with its detection method and confidence level. method: regex_checksum (regex shape + mathematical checksum validation, high-confidence positive match) | column_keyword (fuzzy column-*name* match only, no value inspection -- a guess, low confidence) | schema_check (structural presence/absence check over column names) | regex (pattern/format match, reusing existing shared detection logic where noted). confidence: high (validated / structurally confirmed) | low (heuristic name-based guess that should be surfaced for human review, not treated as a confirmed finding).

PCI_DSS._note: Not populated here. Defined on feature/compliance-config-pci-dss (pci_dss_detectors.py), which was not present in the snapshot this file was generated from. Merge that branch's PCI_DSS section in alongside GLBA/SOX below -- do not hand-author it here.

GLBA.description: Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act -- financial institution customer data.

routing_number.description: 9-digit ABA routing number: regex shape + weighted (3,7,1) mod-10 checksum.

bank_account_number.description: Column name suggests a bank account number field. Name-only guess -- not a confirmed value-level finding.

loan_application_data.description: Column name suggests loan application data (amount, term, type, principal). Name-only guess.

credit_history_data.description: Column name suggests credit history / credit score data. Name-only guess.

tax_return_data.description: Column name suggests tax return data (AGI, W2/1099 income, filing status). Name-only guess.

SOX.description: Sarbanes-Oxley Act -- financial reporting controls and audit trail integrity.

audit_trail_headers.description: Structural check that creation, approval, and modification audit-trail columns are all present.

transaction_timestamp.description: Transaction timestamp presence. Reuses the existing shared datetime-column detection logic (column_classifier.is_datetime_column) -- no separate regex/date-parsing logic is implemented for this rule.
